meta.title: 淄博烧烤没热度了怎么救｜定位理论
meta.title_en: Saving Zibo BBQ with Positioning Theory

scenes.context: 讲者设问：淄博烧烤没热度了怎么办？用里斯/特劳特定位理论。
sentences: 资博烧烤没热度了，如果你是资博市长，你怎么办？
Zibo barbecue has lost its buzz. What would you do if you were the mayor of Zibo?
热度：buzz / hype
我的方案是：用里斯和特劳特的定位理论，为资博这座城市重新做定位。
My plan is to re-position the city of Zibo with Ries and Trout's positioning theory.
重新做定位：re-position
定位只要定住了，流量就会随之而来。
Once the positioning sticks, traffic will follow.
定位定住：the positioning sticks
paraphrase: 烧烤没热度 → 流量流失
When the buzz dies down, traffic dries up.
定位定住 → 流量自来
Fix the positioning, and the flow comes on its own.
scenes.speak: Zibo barbecue has lost its buzz. What would you do if you were the mayor of Zibo? My plan is to re-position the city of Zibo with Ries and Trout's positioning theory. Once the positioning sticks, traffic will follow.

scenes.context: 讲者分析烧烤好吃是物理属性易复制，认知属性才占据心智。
sentences: 定位定住的东西，一定是认知层面的东西，不能是物理属性的东西。
What positioning locks in must be cognitive, never a physical attribute.
认知层面：cognitive level
物理属性的东西很容易被复制，大众消费品的技术不是光刻机，你锁不住竞争对手。
Physical attributes are easily copied — mass-market goods don't run on lithography-grade tech that you can lock away from rivals.
锁住竞争对手：lock competitors out
而认知属性一旦占据消费者的心智，就很难再被挤出来。
But once a cognitive attribute seizes the consumer's mindshare, it's nearly impossible to squeeze it out.
占据心智：seize the mindshare
paraphrase: 物理属性 → 容易被复制
Physical attributes are easy to replicate.
认知属性 → 占据心智挤不掉
Cognitive attributes take root in the mind and refuse to leave.
scenes.speak: What positioning locks in must be cognitive, never a physical attribute. Physical attributes are easily copied — mass-market goods don't run on lithography-grade tech that you can lock away from rivals. But once a cognitive attribute seizes the consumer's mindshare, it's nearly impossible to squeeze it out.

scenes.context: 讲者给出人情味证据与最终定位，并延伸产业。
sentences: 别家饭店是中央厨房机器人加预制菜，而资博烧烤是真有师傅摇着扇子给你烤，烤完还跟你喝个小酒聊聊家常——这里面是人情味。
Chain restaurants serve robot-made meals from central kitchens, but in Zibo a real master fans the coals just for you, then shares a drink and small talk — that's warmth.
人情味：warmth / a human touch
当时资博市政府发自内心关心学子、请他们吃烧烤，才有了后来大疆式的涌泉相报——这里面也是人情味。
The Zibo government genuinely cared for the students and treated them to barbecue, which is why they later repaid it in kind, DJI-style — that's warmth too.
涌泉相报：repay in kind
所以定在人情味：人情味的资博，人情味的烧烤。定位不是发明新东西，而是把大众脑中已有的内容凸显出来。
So position on warmth: a warm Zibo, a warm barbecue. Positioning isn't inventing something new — it's highlighting what's already in people's minds.
凸显出来：bring to the fore
paraphrase: 别人做中央厨房 → 我们有人情味
While others automate, we offer human warmth.
定位不是发明，而是凸显已有认知
Positioning amplifies existing perception; it doesn't invent.
scenes.speak: Chain restaurants serve robot-made meals from central kitchens, but in Zibo a real master fans the coals just for you, then shares a drink and small talk — that's warmth. The Zibo government genuinely cared for the students and treated them to barbecue, which is why they later repaid it in kind, DJI-style — that's warmth too. So position on warmth: a warm Zibo, a warm barbecue. Positioning isn't inventing something new — it's highlighting what's already in people's minds.

practice: The barbecue scene has lost its buzz.
Re-position the city with positioning theory.
Physical attributes are easily copied by rivals.
Once it seizes the mindshare, it's hard to shake.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：The barbecue is very delicious to eat.
✓ 地道说法：The barbecue tastes great.
不要逐字说 very delicious to eat，用 taste + 副词最自然。
✕ 直译腔：Position must be put on the cognitive layer.
✓ 地道说法：Positioning must operate at the cognitive level.
layer 是直译，认知层面用 level 更地道。
✕ 直译腔：The traffic will come by itself.
✓ 地道说法：Traffic will follow naturally.
come by itself 是中式英文，用 follow / flow in。
✕ 直译腔：Zibo BBQ has the human flavor.
✓ 地道说法：Zibo BBQ has warmth / a human touch.
人情味不是 human flavor，warmth 或 a human touch 才地道。
shifts: 把定位理解为「找一个营销卖点」
把定位理解为「占据心智的认知」
把卖点放在「物理属性」（烧烤好吃）
把卖点放在「认知属性」（人情味）
在消费者脑中「发明」新概念
在消费者脑中「找出」已有认知并放大
